boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Elizabethtown College
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Elizabethtown destinations with directly documented hours extending to 11 p.m. or later.

cards.title: Close Out the Night at Jay’s Nest
cards.subtitle: Baugher Student Center • campus convenience stop
cards.notes: Head to Baugher Student Center for made-to-order food, grab-and-go items, snacks, drinks, or everyday essentials before midnight.
cards.short_summary: The campus-operated option with normal hours reaching midnight every night.
cards.evidence_claim: Elizabethtown College identifies Jay’s Nest in Baugher Student Center and posts normal operating hours ending at midnight Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Normal hours are 7 a.m.–midnight Monday–Friday and noon–midnight Saturday–Sunday; modified and break hours may supersede them.

cards.title: Use the Around-the-Clock Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: 1284 South Market Street • food and coffee
cards.notes: Check the current ordering channel, then use this South Market Street location when the other documented food counters have closed.
cards.short_summary: A continuously available food stop on the commercial strip south of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Discover Lancaster lists the McDonald’s at 1284 South Market Street in Elizabethtown as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — Lancaster PA | Visit Lancaster PA
cards.access_notes: Listed as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday; confirm the active service channel before departing.

cards.title: Take the South Market Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: 825 South Market Street • customizable fast food
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a late meal, noting that its posted service continues later than the separately listed dine-in schedule.
cards.short_summary: A late drive-thru whose weekend endpoint extends beyond its weekday schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page lists the 825 South Market Street drive-thru until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Restaurant at 825 South Market St
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in hours are shorter.

cards.title: Make a Post-Midnight Wendy’s Run
cards.subtitle: 1660 South Market Street • restaurant and drive-thru
cards.notes: Choose the restaurant or drive-thru for a late meal, and check holiday exceptions before relying on the posted overnight endpoint.
cards.short_summary: Both service channels remain open after midnight throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 1660 South Market Street.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-thru close at 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Order Before Domino’s Midnight Close
cards.subtitle: 1575 South Market Street • carryout and delivery
cards.notes: Place a carryout or delivery order before the displayed closing time, allowing extra time for preparation and any delivery cutoff.
cards.short_summary: A direct-order pizza option documented through midnight on the current location page.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official location page identifies the store at 1575 South Market Street and displays a current closing time of midnight.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 1575 S Market St
cards.access_notes: The official location page displayed “Today Until 12:00 AM” when fetched; hours vary, so verify the live page before ordering.

cards.title: Restock at GIANT Before 11
cards.subtitle: 1278 South Market Street • groceries and essentials
cards.notes: Use the final hour for groceries, snacks, or household supplies; do not assume the pharmacy shares the main store’s closing time.
cards.short_summary: A seven-day grocery run with a consistent documented 11 p.m. store endpoint.
cards.evidence_claim: GIANT’s official store page lists the 1278 South Market Street supermarket from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: GIANT at 1278 S Market St Elizabethtown, PA
cards.access_notes: The main store closes at 11 p.m. daily; pharmacy, pickup, and other department hours end earlier.

cards.title: Use the 24-Hour South Market Stop
cards.subtitle: 1500 South Market Street • convenience store
cards.notes: Stop here for hot food, packaged snacks, drinks, or basic travel supplies when scheduled restaurant and grocery hours have ended.
cards.short_summary: A named South Market convenience stop explicitly documented as operating around the clock.
cards.evidence_claim: 7-Eleven’s official page lists its 1500 South Market Street location as open 24 hours and 24/7.
cards.source_title: 1500 S Market St in Elizabethtown, PA | 7-Eleven
cards.access_notes: The convenience store is listed as open 24/7; individual food, delivery, or other services may have separate availability.

cards.title: Reach Sunoco Before 11
cards.subtitle: 550 East High Street • fuel and convenience stop
cards.notes: Use this east-side option for fuel or convenience items, arriving before the official location page’s posted 11 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: An alternative to the South Market cluster with a verified late-evening endpoint.
cards.evidence_claim: Sunoco’s official Elizabethtown page identifies the station at 550 East High Street and lists it open from 5 a.m. to 11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Gas Stations Near Me in Elizabethtown, PA | Sunoco
cards.access_notes: The official listing posts a 5 a.m.–11 p.m. operating window; arrive earlier if a specific store service is essential.

cards.title: Take the North Market 24-Hour Option
cards.subtitle: 245 North Market Street • convenience store
cards.notes: Choose this north-of-downtown stop for packaged food, drinks, or travel basics without relying on a scheduled closing hour.
cards.short_summary: One of Elizabethtown’s map-listed Turkey Hill locations with documented all-day access.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists the Turkey Hill convenience store at 245 North Market Street as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Turkey Hill in Elizabethtown, PA | Apple Maps
cards.access_notes: Listed as open 24 hours every day; confirm current access before making a dedicated overnight trip.

cards.entity_name: Turkey Hill at 549 South Market Street
cards.title: Use the South Market Turkey Hill
cards.subtitle: 549 South Market Street • 24-hour gas station store
cards.notes: Use this closer-in South Market option for convenience items or fuel when dining counters are closed and timing is uncertain.
cards.short_summary: A second, distinct Turkey Hill address documented for continuous daily operation.
cards.evidence_claim: Apple Maps lists the Turkey Hill gas station at 549 South Market Street as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: Turkey Hill at 549 S Market St | Apple Maps
cards.access_notes: Listed as open 24 hours every day; fuel, food, and other individual services may have separate availability.
